info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Prioritys-v4-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Priorities API allows users to access and list various priorities assigned to support tickets. This endpoint is essential for organizations that require clear categorization of ticket urgency in their support systems. Developers and support teams can utilize this resource to better manage workflows and escalate issues effectively. Use cases include prioritizing customer queries and aligning support response strategies with ticket severity levels.

get.summary: Retrieve the priority levels of tickets.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the various priority levels assigned to tickets within the system. It helps in understanding the urgency and handling order of different tickets.
